how: The flag proposals give participants a concrete collective mark around which to gather.
Calls invite members to make the flag and join its construction.
Proposals provide a shared project to answer, with recruitment sometimes already present in the proposing turn.
Calls precede progress reports, but the written sequence does not establish which placements the calls caused.
Participants judge their active numbers minuscule compared with other communities.
A first design is made small enough for the available hands to build quickly and maintain easily.
An explicit agreement with the low-participation assessment makes initial design size depend on building and maintenance capacity.
Preventive sizing and a larger-flag proposal retaining the Heart do not establish relocation after loss.
Low participation explains preventive sizing here, so a loss and relocation must be independently evidenced before applying the move mechanism.
A participant answers encouragement with a bare assent and elsewhere reports completion in one word.
The encouragement not to give up receives a bare commitment, while silent acceptance and a general obligation to answer remain untested.
The national flag is proposed as the room's shared mark.
Participants report completion, approaching completion and the remaining outline work.
Location links and shared image plans provide a common reference for the flag.
A posted template does not settle design when participants continue deciding the cross and negotiating the outline afterward.
Coordinates and a colour sequence remain visible as struck-through plans, preserving revision rather than a single settled instruction.
Sizing a flag and observing the normal placement interval do not establish scripts, bots or spare accounts.
Defence promises and build instructions do not establish whether formal order was decided in unseen discussions.

statement: Separate personal canvas projects from the room's collective project.
how: A personal lettering request and individual participation in the void coexist with flag organising without establishing collective adoption of either project.
Participants promise defence and ask others to maintain the flag during a sign-off.
A late participant explicitly substitutes future defence for construction they missed.
Informal responsibility transfer includes teasing a late helper and asking remaining participants to keep the flag intact.
Maintaining an existing mark can accompany an expansion attempt instead of requiring growth to stop.
A participant asks who spoiled the design without identifying a culprit or completing an investigation.
Defence calls do not reveal whether any unseen participant later adopted automated placement.
Participants negotiate the outline and describe purple as a compromise between the void and heart placers.
Negotiation overlaps design and building, so maintenance pressure cannot be assigned a distinct causal phase from this sequence alone.
A negotiator takes a design into another group's chat and returns permission and the limits of promised assistance to the local thread.
A participant reports conducting the permission discussion in another group's Discord.
Reported permission to take a heart and an application for another group's space show the guest-side entry into hosted territory.
A proposed application establishes neither approved residence nor enforced host rules, which remain unresolved without the missing response.
Participants request help from named communities and separately report receiving help from unspecified friends.
Seeking outside help does not establish that a requested group sends it, because permission is reported without a concrete assistance commitment.
Negotiated access and reciprocal labour must remain separate when permission is granted but help is expressly unconfirmed.
The outline agreement does not itself document sparing or restoring another group's work.
Negotiation is visible but a subsequent restraint response is not established by the surviving concepts.
A conversation in another group's chat and requests for help do not establish a coalition or mutual defence commitment.
The defence pledge and external help requests do not show entry into a shared defence coalition.
Questions about a missing proposal and a compromise do not establish a dispute over who can bind the room.
The negotiation exchange contains no explicit authority challenge, while unseen chat terms prevent a definitive negative finding.
The national mark and locally voiced small-but-strong celebration support ordinary belonging carried into the shared effort.
Individual participation in an outside faction does not establish that the room collectively adopts its colour or doctrine.
Resistance from the void is described in present canvas terms without evidence of an inherited quarrel.
No cited turn ties a pre-canvas rivalry to a collective attack call.
Recognising Reddit's April Fools feature and discussing the Button do not establish host parody or a local licence for doubtful claims.

statement: Participants compare the event with a past event known second-hand.
how: Archive-based recollection lets participants prefer or regret missing an earlier event while admitting that they speak as if they had attended.
Defence calls and a complaint about canvas politics do not establish a rule containing canvas discussion in the host subreddit.
The flag call is visible but no flood-induced host boundary response is established.

statement: Participants appraise the difficulty of canvas politics without regulating their host forum.
how: Calling the politics vicious supplies an appraisal of the attempt's environment rather than a boundary around permitted subreddit talk.
Participants announce success, credit helpers and celebrate a shared accomplishment before and after placement ends.
Completion is immediately marked by a small-but-strong collective celebration.
Celebratory participation can be humorous and coexist with explicitly not understanding the accomplishment.
A linked progress image minimally records a reported state without establishing a final archive or revealing its unseen visual contents.
A progress-image link and celebration do not establish that celebrating caused a later preservation practice.
Post-close praise contains no decision to retain the organisation, emblem or project beyond the canvas.
The progress record and later praise do not establish a preservation-to-continuation sequence.
The surviving post-close praise does not contest cleanup, a retained canvas version or an account of the event.
Personal void involvement and resistance to its pressure do not establish a collective attack call.
Recruitment for the flag is visible without an evidenced turn toward attacking a rival's work.
Teasing a late helper and laughing together are internal banter rather than documented contest talk with a rival room.
An attack-to-restraint mechanism cannot be tested without an identified collective attack call.
The outline negotiation cannot test an attack-to-deal mechanism without evidence of the initiating attack call.
No identified collective attack call supplies an antecedent for testing subsequent inter-room contest talk.
Expected host maintenance makes a spot attractive, but it must be distinguished from reported permission and a confirmed protection commitment.
